The function requests attribute selectors 0x0f and 0x10 through convert_attribute_value_to_float_div_100, adds the returned floats, multiplies the sum by 0.5, then returns category 0, 1, or 2 based on comparisons against float constants 0.65 and 0.85 (decompiled/main/main_0094.c:6015-6044).
